url: Official Feeder repository documentation and F-Droid listing
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Feeder (com.nononsenseapps.feeder), version F-Droid build 4050.

features.name: Add a feed by URL
features.description: Add a feed by URL as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the "+" floating action button (Add feed)
paste or type the feed or website address
select the discovered feed from the results
optionally set the title and tag

features.name: Add a feed by sharing a link from another app
features.description: Add a feed by sharing a link from another app as documented for Feeder.
actions: In a browser or another app, tap Share on the page link
the add-feed screen opens with the URL pre-filled

features.name: Edit a feed
features.description: Edit a feed as documented for Feeder.
actions: long-press the feed (or open it and use the overflow menu)
change the title, the tag, the full-text setting, the notification setting and the article opener

features.name: Delete a feed
features.description: Delete a feed as documented for Feeder.

features.name: Organise feeds into tags/groups
features.description: Organise feeds into tags/groups as documented for Feeder.
actions: type a new tag name or pick an existing one
tap Save; the drawer then groups the feeds under that tag

features.name: Read an article
features.description: Read an article as documented for Feeder.
actions: Open a feed or the "All feeds" view
the reader view opens with the title, image and text
swipe or use the navigation arrows to move to the next article

features.name: Fetch the full article text
features.description: Fetch the full article text as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the "Full text"/reader toggle in the toolbar (or enable "Fetch full articles" for the feed in its editor)
the complete page content is downloaded and rendered

features.name: Open an article in the browser
features.description: Open an article in the browser as documented for Feeder.
actions: the page opens in the default browser or a custom tab according to the settings

features.name: Mark an article as read or unread
features.description: Mark an article as read or unread as documented for Feeder.
actions: swipe the item sideways to toggle its read state, or open the article (which marks it read) and use the overflow menu

features.name: Mark all articles as read
features.description: Mark all articles as read as documented for Feeder.
actions: Open a feed or the All feeds view
tap the "Mark all as read"/tick-all icon in the toolbar

features.name: Star (bookmark) an article
features.description: Star (bookmark) an article as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the star/bookmark icon in the toolbar; starred articles are kept and can be filtered separately

features.name: Filter the article list
features.description: Filter the article list as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose to show all articles, only unread articles, only starred articles or only recently read ones

features.name: Sort the article list
features.description: Sort the article list as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose newest first or oldest first

features.name: Search articles
features.description: Search articles as documented for Feeder.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar

features.name: Listen to an article with text to speech
features.description: Listen to an article with text to speech as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the "Read aloud"/text-to-speech icon in the toolbar
use the play, pause and stop controls
the reading continues in a notification

features.name: Share an article
features.description: Share an article as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose the destination app in the Android share sheet

features.name: Refresh feeds manually
features.description: Refresh feeds manually as documented for Feeder.
actions: pull down to refresh, or tap the sync/refresh icon in the toolbar
wait for the update to complete

features.name: Configure automatic background syncing
features.description: Configure automatic background syncing as documented for Feeder.
actions: set the sync interval (for example every hour, every few hours or manually)
choose whether syncing is limited to Wi-Fi and whether it runs while charging only

features.name: Enable new-article notifications
features.description: Enable new-article notifications as documented for Feeder.
actions: enable notifications for the feed or globally
new items then produce a notification

features.name: Import feeds from an OPML file
features.description: Import feeds from an OPML file as documented for Feeder.
actions: Open the navigation drawer or Settings
select the .opml file with the picker
confirm; the feeds and their tags are added

features.name: Export feeds to an OPML file
features.description: Export feeds to an OPML file as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose the destination file name and folder

features.name: Synchronise read state between devices
features.description: Synchronise read state between devices as documented for Feeder.
actions: create a sync chain on one device and copy the code/link
on the other device tap "Join sync chain" and paste it
confirm; read and starred states are then shared

features.name: Set how many articles are kept per feed
features.description: Set how many articles are kept per feed as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the "Maximum number of items per feed"/retention entry

features.name: Choose the default article opener
features.description: Choose the default article opener as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose the reader view, the custom tab or the external browser

features.name: Change the theme
features.description: Change the theme as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose light, dark, e-ink or "follow system"
optionally enable dynamic (Material You) colours or the pure-black dark theme

features.name: Change the reader font, text size and alignment
features.description: Change the reader font, text size and alignment as documented for Feeder.
actions: set the font, the text size and whether the text is justified

features.name: Control image loading
features.description: Control image loading as documented for Feeder.
actions: choose whether images are loaded always, only on Wi-Fi or never
optionally enable the thumbnail display in the article list

features.name: Choose the swipe gesture behaviour
features.description: Choose the swipe gesture behaviour as documented for Feeder.
actions: set what a swipe on an article row does (for example mark as read or nothing) and whether swiping between articles is enabled

features.name: Block articles by keyword
features.description: Block articles by keyword as documented for Feeder.
actions: enter the word or phrase to filter out
confirm; matching articles are hidden from the lists

features.name: Change the article list layout
features.description: Change the article list layout as documented for Feeder.
actions: tap the feed item style/layout entry
choose the compact, card or super-compact presentation

features.name: View the about screen and licences
features.description: View the about screen and licences as documented for Feeder.
actions: read the version, the source link, the privacy policy and the open-source licences
